issue.title: Organization URL does update when changing the name field.

issue.body:
## Bug Report
### Current Behavior
On the [/organization](https://dev.to/settings/organization) page, changing the `name` field to change the name of my organization, will save. But does not actually change the associated URL

### Expected Behavior
Changing the `name` field in an organization, changes the actual URL of the organization.

### Additional Info (device/browser, helpful links)
Chrome `69.0.3497.42` on linux

related to #417

body: Done #462. I updated the description here to just reflect the title.

I started to look into this issue, but I was having trouble reproducing it. Maybe I'm not looking at the right place, but here are the steps I followed.

1. I have an existing organization.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/634902/45847605-88097580-bcf9-11e8-9f31-e52468dfc745.png)

2. I change the name and click the submit button.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/634902/45847626-9b1c4580-bcf9-11e8-96cf-d273b1d91f16.png)

3. The organization name has been changed.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/634902/45847643-a7a09e00-bcf9-11e8-8785-9acbba2158dd.png)

@autoferrit Are there any steps I might be missing?

I just went to my organization page, and tried changing the name, in this image, you can see i just saved it and it shows the old name.
![devtoorg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/89895/45918646-fad03900-be3e-11e8-96c0-c5ab8d2a625f.png)
I dont even see where your screenshot of the name would come from.

Ok, so I found my public organization page. It does show the updated name.  But, the name is wrong in the admin UI, and the url for the organization still shows the old url. But that is in ticket #462
@autoferrit Sorry about that. I should've been more clear in my steps. What you said is what I was seeing as well. The name changes on the public organization page.
